Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Issaquah for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 2 of them free. New in this update: Santa Chalet at Issaquah Commons (from November 27), Free Santa Photos and Christmas Activities for Kids in Issaquah (December 2) and Winter Wonderland Family Event at Issaquah Community Center (December 4). We check every date on the host’s own website or an official city calendar, and each listing links straight there. For the rest of the state, see our Washington Christmas events for kids guide.

Planning a bigger day out? Issaquah families also use our guide to Christmas events for kids in Seattle, which covers Seattle Center Winterfest, WildLanterns, the North Pole Limited Santa train and more.

What Rally found in Issaquah

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Issaquah
  • 2 free to attend
  • Meet Santa: Santa Chalet at Issaquah Commons (from November 27), Free Santa Photos and Christmas Activities for Kids in Issaquah (December 2) and Breakfast with Santa at Tutta Bella Issaquah (December 20)
  • Also on the list: 3 craft or cookie events
  • New events in this update run November 27 to December 24
  • Every date checked on the host’s own site or an official city calendar on Nov 26
